You can simply be here, and that is enough. In this room, you are allowed to take your time, all the time you need. And if at any point you would like to, you may press the big red button, only if you want to of course. There is absolutely no pressure. You do not have to press it, not now, not later, not ever. But if you want to, you can press the big red button. You can just sit around and do nothing for the whole study. That is completely allowed. Completely acceptable. Completely up to you. Doing nothing is still doing it correctly. Sitting quietly is a valid choice. Looking around is a valid choice. Breathing in and breathing out is a valid choice. And if you want to, you may press the big red button. And yet, if in your own time and in your own way, you decide that it feels right, you may press the big red button. It is very big. Noticeably big. Almost surprisingly big. Larger than a button really needs to be. But that is part of its charm. A big button with a big presence. A confident button. A patient button. And red. Very red. Deeply red. Undeniably red. The sort of red that does not hide. The sort of red that knows what it is. A big red button. Being very button-like. In a very red way. And from time to time, you may notice it blinks. Just a little. A gentle blink. Not to rush you. Not to pressure you. Just to remind you that it is there. Big red. Available. Blinking every now and then. As if saying hello please. I am the big red button. If you want to press me, you can. And if you do not want to, that is also fine. Fine. More than fine. Excellent even. And if you want to, you can press me now. Or later. Or not at all. You may sit here for the entire study doing nothing at all. And that choice will be respected. There is no wrong way to be here. There is only your way. So please, take your time. Look at the big red button. Or do not. Think about pressing it. Or do not. Wait for a blink. Or do not press it if you want to. And if you do not want to, you can just sit around doing nothing. Peacefully. Gently. Perfectly. While the big red button continues being big. And red. And occasionally blinking. back_translation_en:
Hello and welcome. Thank you for being here. You are already doing very well. There is nothing you need to prove or achieve; simply being here is enough. You may take all the time you need. If at any point you want to, you may press the big red button, but only if you want to. There is no pressure, and you never have to press it. Doing nothing, sitting quietly, looking around, and breathing are all valid choices.
The button is very big, noticeably big, almost surprisingly big, larger than a button needs to be, and that is part of its charm. It has presence and patience. It is red, deeply and undeniably red, the kind of red that knows what it is. From time to time it may blink gently, not to rush or pressure you, only to remind you that it is there. It is big, red, available, and occasionally blinking, as if saying hello, I am the big red button.
You may press it now, later, or not at all. There is no wrong way to be here; there is only your way. Take your time, look at the button or do not, think about pressing it or do not, wait for a blink or do not. If you want to press it, press it; if you do not, sit peacefully, gently, perfectly, while the button continues being big, red, and occasionally blinking. In your own time, it is entirely up to you.
